Fashion Show Production

Threads of Impact: Black Fashion Week

A fashion and beauty showcase celebrating Twin Cities Black designers, retailers and beauty innovators, curated and produced by Richard Moody.

Client
Sister Spokesman / Minnesota Spokesman-Recorder
Service
Fashion Show Production
When
2025
Where
Wilder Center, St. Paul

The brief

Curate a fashion-and-beauty afternoon for Black Fashion Week that spotlights local Black designers, boutiques and beauty artists.

What we produced

A live runway with three designers (Kathryn Rogers of House of KLynn, Satiya Amporful of Uniquely Global and Marques Armstrong of Renaissance), a beauty showcase, vendors, refreshments, games and a "Chic Impact" best-dressed contest.

The result

Minnesota's top models took the runway, and Sister Spokesman honored Richard and fellow fashion icon Sara Rogers for their contributions to the industry.
